why: The vocabulary check dropped, so `--arrival converge` -- the name of one HALF of this language, and exactly what someone who read the issue would type -- is forwarded to the page, fails `isArrivalLanguage` there, resolves to null, and shoots the shipped treatment while reporting success. args.mjs cannot import the TypeScript that owns ARRIVAL_LANGUAGES, so this hardcoded list plus its two-way pin is the only thing keeping the CLI honest.
killedBy: gallery args pins --arrival to the vocabulary the renderer actually owns
